title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: refuse the bare publish and rollback of a name only disabled packages hold, with or without a package-less row (#37851)

Fixes #37851

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` teaches a per-item publish or rollback naming no package over a name only disabled packages hold; the refusal's own sentence names the fix

## 维护者速读

- 包停用后，不指明包的单项发布和回滚以前还能写进去（发布写进停用包自己的行，回滚把已删的无包定制重新插回来），现在和保存一样被拒绝，什么都不写。
- 这是 #37851 裁定 A 「两处都拒绝」的实现，外加裁定要求先测的第三格（停用包自有行的裸回滚）：实测在 main 上也落地，所以一并拒绝。
- 写包自己的行的两种（发布自有草稿、回滚自有行）提示"指明包"（`?package=`），指明包后照常写；会把无包行插回来的回滚提示"先启用包"。指明包的写、读、启用后的行为都不变；本改动可整体撤回。
- 无

## What changes

Ruling A on #37851 (comment 7216539589, maintainer 「两处都拒绝」): the per-item publish and rollback naming no package refuse a name only disabled packages hold, as the bare save does, whether or not a package-less row is stored. PR #37818 made both doors ask the disabled-holders judgment only where they read or write a package-unbound row that is already stored; three cells were left writing.

- **Cell (a), per-item publish of the disabled package's own draft** (`promoteDraftForPublish`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts`): where no package is named and the draft address is the package's own draft (`key` and `into` that package), the door now asks `packagelessHolderRefusal` (`arms: 'disabled-holders'`) with `unbound: false`. Over a name only disabled packages hold it answers `disabledHoldersOnlyRefusal` (verb `publish`): `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, "Name the package this publish is for, then send it again …", the bare save's own sentence there. That holds whether or not a package-less row is stored beside it, because the promotion never touches that row and the publish naming the package reaches the draft. This flips the control pin #37818 added (its line 320).
- **Cell (b), per-item rollback with the package-less row's history but no row stored** (`rollbackMetaItemUnaudited`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-commits.ts`): the `active.unbound` precondition is dropped. Where the restore writes the package-unbound row (`rollbackPackageId === null`), stored or not, the door answers `disabledHoldersCustomizationRefusal` (verb `rollback`): `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, "Enable the package that holds …". The restore would have inserted the package-unbound row again, which is the disabled holder's customization.
- **Cell (c), per-item rollback of the disabled package's own row** (same door): measured first, as the ruling asks. On `main` 73d5e347 it answered `success: true` and restored the row (pin below, red on main). Refused in this PR as (a) is: `unbound: false`, `disabledHoldersOnlyRefusal` (verb `rollback`), and the rollback naming the package still restores it.

The rollback's candidate set is the active rows' bindings plus the restore's binding, so a `.custom` pair of a disabled base is judged the way the save judges it. The judgment returns `undefined` with any enabled holder, so every answer over an enabled package is unchanged. The `packagelessHolderRefusal` docblock now says which state each door asks.

Also in this PR:
- **Migration entry** `disabled-holder-package-less-row-bare-write-refused` (spec, pending release): the surface, replacement, reason and acceptance criteria name the three cells and their two remedies. The `reason` sentence L2 S1 on #37818 required ("with none stored they judge no holder … not refused by this entry") is replaced with what the doors now do.
- **New changeset** `.changeset/37851-disabled-holder-own-row-publish-rollback-refused.md`: `minor` for metadata-protocol and spec, BREAKING scoped to the three cells, ADR-0087 `not-required (already-registered disabled-holder-package-less-row-bare-write-refused)`. Its "Not moved" paragraph also carries the correction to the 37608 note (next bullet).
- **No edit to the released note** `.changeset/pre/37608-disabled-holder-publish-rollback-refused.md`. The release PR #37661 (`19.0.0-next.1`) consumed it, so this PR keeps `main`'s blob byte for byte (seat ruling, Option B, comment 7222609810). Its "Not moved" list still names these three cells as landing; the #37851 changeset above states the correction, and whether to edit the pre/ text before GA is the release owner's call. `Check Changeset` is green.
- ADR-0150 D3 note wording (`docs/adr/**`) is not in this diff; the seat carries it to the ADR checklist, per the ruling.

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/disabled-holder-packageless-row-doors.test.ts`, inside the `describe` #37818 added (same fixture: `com.acme.mail` ships `email_template` `acme.welcome` in en-US / zh-CN; `fr-FR` is a member it never ships, the cell the D11 close leaves open):

- publish, the package's own draft, `it.each` over beside the stored package-less row (the flipped :320 control) and with no package-less row stored: refused 409 with the `?package=` sentence, no package named, every stored row byte-identical. CONTROL: the publish naming the package promotes it, the package-less row byte-identical.
- CONTROL: publish of the package's own draft, re-enabled: the bare publish promotes it as on `main`.
- rollback with the package-less row's history but no row stored (saved twice, deleted, then disabled): refused 409 with the enable sentence, no row inserted. CONTROL: re-enabled, the same rollback restores the version.
- rollback of the package's own row (saved twice with `packageId`, then disabled): refused 409 with the `?package=` sentence, nothing written. CONTROL: the rollback naming the package restores it; re-enabled, it is served.

<details><summary>Measurement, reach on main, fix</summary>

- **Served-stack measurement before the ruling** (real `RestServer` routes over the real ObjectQL engine and protocol, in-memory driver, this fixture, `origin/main` 0a3ea67c): recorded on the card, comment 7216513948. Bare `PUT` answered `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`; bare `POST /publish` and bare `POST /rollback` answered `200` and wrote.
- **Reach on `main` 73d5e347** (pins committed first as 1217b6a5, run against main's `metadata-protocol` build): `Tests 5 failed | 9 passed (14)`. The four refusal pins and the re-enabled publish control failed with `no refusal: expected [ undefined, undefined ] to deeply equal [ 409, 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT' ]`; that includes cell (c), so the ruling's third cell lands on `main`.
- **Fix** (42bb7de2, metadata-protocol rebuilt): `Tests 14 passed (14)`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The enable sentence says "the row stored for it under no package is that package's customization". In cell (b) no such row is stored at the moment of the refusal; its history is, and the restore would store it. The ruling names that sentence for (b), so this PR keeps it unchanged.
- In-process `publishMetaItem` with `packageId: null` present (#37818 record N1) still takes the named branch; unchanged here.
